info.title: Image-Charts Universal API
info.description: Generate charts, GraphViz graphs, QR codes, and Chart.js images

get.description: Creates a Base64-encoded Chart.js image chart with Image-Charts.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

data.description: Binary image bytes returned by Image-Charts.

type.description: Node.js buffer type label from the raw binary response wrapper.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.
